summary: a declared suspension stops the stand-in QEMU thirty times, holds each stop with no tick of the stand-in inside it and resumes it, and a stop signal, a step's bound and a kill of the scenario during a stop each leave no stopped machine

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host -I tools/etude/include -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/posix -I tools/etude/guest -I utils tests/host/etude_scenario_hosttest.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/posix/scenario.c tools/etude/posix/case_main.c tools/etude/serial.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/posix/qemu.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/posix/exec.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/posix/keeper.c tools/etude/posix/process.c tools/etude/posix/store.c tools/etude/capture.c tools/etude/history_json.c tools/etude/guest/guest.c tools/etude/guest/fixture.c tools/etude/guest/wire.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/test

faults.name: never-stopped
faults.summary: the keeper takes a stop but sends no SIGSTOP

faults.name: never-continued
faults.summary: the keeper takes a resumption but sends no SIGCONT

faults.name: stop-as-exit
faults.summary: the keeper takes the stopped QEMU for one that has ended

faults.name: unseen-stop
faults.summary: the scenario holds a stop that was asked for but not yet seen

faults.name: stop-not-held
faults.summary: the scenario resumes the QEMU as soon as it is seen stopped

faults.name: left-stopped
faults.summary: a suspension that a stop signal or a step's bound ends returns with the QEMU stopped

faults.name: loss-left-stopped
faults.summary: a keeper whose controller has gone sends SIGTERM to the stopped QEMU but no SIGCONT

lines: suspend-kill: the stopped QEMU took its SIGTERM
